description: Task C: matcher + evidence model + check service. Turns Claim[] plus RepoIndex into ClaimResult[] and Report per PLAN.md section 7, and exposes checkDocument / checkClaim used by resolvers and actions. Can start in parallel against FEAT-001 contracts with hand-made index fixtures; the demo golden test needs FEAT-002, FEAT-003 and FEAT-007 outputs.
steps: src/core/match/<type>.ts: one matcher per claim type implementing the PLAN.md 7.2 verdict table exactly (Contradicted only with complete coverage; partial/none coverage, external hosts, programs not in repo yield Unknown).

src/core/match/nearest.ts: ranking for routes (same method first, path similarity, version-prefix swap /v1/ <-> /v2/), env vars (shared tokens + Jaro-Winkler), flags, config sibling keys, moved files (same basename); top 3.
src/core/ids.ts: stable c_ and ev_ ids (hash of sha, file, line, kind) using a pure hash (no node:crypto in core, or inject a hasher).
src/core/wording.ts: implement templates from PLAN.md 7.4; statements only come from here; snippets truncated to 160 chars with control chars stripped.
src/core/match/report.ts: build Report (counts, limits, coverage, stale) and the pil.agent.v1 envelope (PLAN.md 9.2) with untrusted* fields and dataNotice.

src/service/check.ts: checkDocument({ adf, repoRef }) and checkClaim({ text, repoRef }) that load the index via src/storage (FEAT-003), run extractor (FEAT-002) and matcher, apply report cache report:{hash} and counts:{contentId}:{version}.

Tests: verdict table row by row with fixture indexes; nearest ranking; id stability; demo golden test (6 verdicts incl. src/routes.ts:88) and fixed-page test (claim 1 Verified at src/routes.ts:88); prompt-injection parity test (injected repo comments and page text produce identical verdicts and appear only in untrusted fields).
acceptance_criteria: npm test passes for test/core/match and test/service
Golden test: broken runbook gives 2 verified, 3 contradicted, 1 unknown; claim POST /v1/charge cites src/routes.ts:88 with nearest POST /v2/payments
Fixed runbook gives claim 1 verified citing src/routes.ts:88
Every statement string passes the banned-words test; Unknown statements contain 'not a confirmation'
